title: Can we use aligner and g2p models for custom data
body: I understand that some parts of this work are not released for security reasons. My question is, can we use the aligner and the g2p model for our custom data, for aligning data (filtering bad data) and general G2P conversion?
author: wincing2

comments.body: @wincing2  sure, you can use the aligner for TTS training (which is easier than Montreal Forced Aligner and more accurate than CTC-based phoneme aligner or Whisper Aligner) and g2p for TTS inference.

title: What's the difference between Natural Speech 3?
body: As stated, is there any essential difference from NS3 published 1 yr ago, besides swapping discrete diffusion to a continuous one?🤔
author: Plachtaa

comments.body:
@Plachtaa  
1) A 25Hz wavvae with more compact and discriminative latents. 
2) A flow-matching diffusion transformer with: multi-conditional CFG、amo sampler、Logit-normal time schedule sampling ...

The above are two main enhancement.
